content: CRITICAL local finding from locked dashmap-6.2.1 source: default S = std::collections::hash_map::RandomState, i.e. SipHash-1-3 per Rust 1.80.0 std source doc comment, NOT ahash. rustkmer src has zero direct ahash usage; ahash only reaches the merge accumulator via hashbrown 0.14 default features. DashMap exposes with_hasher, with_capacity_and_hasher, with_capacity_and_hasher_and_shard_amount; default shard amount = (available_parallelism*4).next_power_of_two(). count.rs sorts output by default (D-09) so a hasher swap preserves golden baselines. Hash computed before shard lock: faster hasher cuts per-op CPU, not lock contention.
